Loops Inside Claude Code (Stop Prompting, Start Designing Loops)

I don't prompt Claude anymore, I write loops that prompt it for me. This is how I set up loops inside Claude Code that read my GitHub issues every 5 minutes, branch, fix, commit, open a PR, merge to main, and close the issue on their own. The same automation approach behind TiltIt, PenAnywhere, and Impromptly AI.

In this video you'll learn:
• Why writing loops beats prompting every time
• The GitHub loop that fixes issues on autopilot
• Polling loops vs dynamic loops explained
• How to design your first loop from scratch
